entries.what: Bluecoast Consulting Engineers (2020) Albany Artificial Surf Reef - Detailed Design Report P19024_DetailedDesign_R2.00 (cross-sections, 2017 bathymetry, coordinates)
entries.where: https://albany.wa.gov.au/documents/801/albany-artificial-surf-reef-executive-summary-detailed-design ; City of Albany SOSR project pages
entries.detail: Only the executive summary is public; the full Detailed Design Report (cross-sections, 2017 bathymetry, footprint coordinates, vertical datum) is not on the City site. The design table/plan (design.jpg) and project profile give crest -1.00 m AHD, 34,000 m3 and a plan outline (these are references) but no seabed levels, pile height, side slopes or toe level, which is what blocks the 3D model. A search for a post-construction (as-built) survey also found nothing.
entries.might_work: Lior: E9 (e-mail the City of Albany project team) / P12; search `"P19024" Bluecoast Albany detailed design report`

entries.what: Post-construction (as-built) survey, monitoring results, beach-width surveys or ecology data for the Southern Ocean Surf Reef (practical completion March 2025)
entries.where: City of Albany project pages; web searches by the card, shape and verification agents (2026-09-24 to 2026-10-10)
entries.by: agent: Albany shape agent (queue item 9) and card verification
entries.detail: No as-built survey, monitoring report, beach-width data or fisheries / ecology data found in any source fetched. Hence the default outline is the Bluecoast final-design outline (a design drawing of the built version), not a measured survey; a visible-reef trace on Esri 2026-01-20 is the toggle. Gemini's '2022 post-construction monitoring' cannot exist for a reef built 2024-25.

entries.what: Albany Advertiser 'Eighteen rocks of Southern Ocean Surf Reef repositioned in successful bid to reduce user injuries' (2026-03-11) and other Albany Advertiser reef articles
entries.detail: Headline, byline and date are confirmed (and a Wayback cross-check), but the article body is paywalled. The AUD 20,000 repositioning cost rests on search-engine synthesis of the paywalled article, not on a second independent source. How far the March 2026 rock move changed the planform is unquantified (assumption A9).

entries.by: agent: Albany shape agent and verification (2026-09-25)
entries.detail: Gemini's three references carry no URLs and could not be fetched or found by search. Its numbers equal the City page's (area 13,500 m2 is within 3 % of our design outline by coincidence of the same City numbers) but its orientation is unsupported, the 'Post-Construction Monitoring 2022' document cannot exist for a reef built 2024-25, and the '> $9 million' Boardriders quote has no source (the sourced total is AUD 11.75M). Gemini lead not confirmed; nothing used.
